resolves #5855

**- Why I did it**
Remove extensive output in teamd to fix #5855 

**- How I did it**
By commenting out the debug output in the code

**- How to verify it**
Build and image, run on your dut. Check that `grep 'usock: calling method' /var/log/teamd.log` shows nothing.
